subject: POC trial environment - next steps & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap and POC options (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC)

Alex, thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of needs:
- Evaluate inference latency and cost for your document-extraction pipeline (avg doc length ~2k tokens).
- Confirm data isolation and audit requirements for regulated customers.
- Run a 2-week POC with realistic traffic (burst to 50 r/s, steady 10 r/s).

Success criteria (suggested):
1) 95th percentile generation latency < 400ms for 2k-token inputs under steady load.
2) Token cost <$0.015 per 1k tokens for your steady-state workload.
3) KV/prefix cache reduces repeat-token cost by >=30% on your sample dataset.
4) Logging & audit events available to your security team (S3 export + retention policy).

POC environment options (pros/cons):
- Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood-hosted, quick onboarding, limited network isolation. Great for feature validation and perf baselining.
- Dedicated sandbox: Reserved GPU pool in our infra, predictable performance and isolation; needs a short capacity setup (~3 business days).
- VPC trial (private): Full VPC peering or private deployment; supports stricter compliance but requires procurement & networking (2\u20133 weeks typical).

Immediate ask:
- Which environment do you prefer to start with? If you want faster time-to-results, we recommend starting hosted and then lifting to dedicated or VPC for compliance validation.
- Confirm internal owners for the POC and procurement contact (if applicable).

I've attached a short POC checklist and a config template for dedicated sandboxes. I cc'd Neha (AE) who will own commercial coordination. If you want, we can loop in Dev Patel (SE) for a short technical kickoff.

Next step: propose a 30-minute kickoff available Thurs 10/7 9-11am PT or Fri 10/8 1-3pm PT.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: 2026-10-04T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onboarding details and technical checklist

Alex, thanks for the details. Quick technical notes and next steps for hosted trial kickoff: 

1) Hosted trial limitations:
- No VPC peering, but we provide encrypted transport and per-tenant logging. Good for perf baselining.

2) Data upload:
- Please share an S3 bucket with read permissions to poc-ingest@redwood.ai or upload via a secure share link. Max single-file size 2GB; total dataset size should be <200GB for quick ingestion.

3) Test harness & scripts:
- I'll provide a JMeter + Python harness to run the steady/burst patterns and collect metrics. We'll also seed the KV cache with your top 10k prefixes so cache behavior is realistic.

4) Dedicated sandbox prep:
- I spun up a candidate config (see attached). If you need GPU type X or pinned capacity windows, let me know. Setup ETA: 3 business days after signed SOW/payment.

5) Security artifacts:
- For procurement/security: we can provide SOC2 report, data flow diagrams, and an audit-event sample export. If Sam needs anything specific for VPC review, we can schedule a short call with our security team.

I'll drop the test harness repo link in the kickoff meeting notes. Looking forward to Thurs.

— Dev
